flow.noFreePlan: There is no free plan and no free trial. Every package is paid. The 4 free extras come with a paid package.

faqs.q: Do I have to choose a design?
faqs.a: No. You tell us about your business and show us sites you like. Our studio builds yours from that brief.

faqs.q: Is it really RM79 (US$19)?
faqs.a: Yes. Launch is RM79 (US$19) for the first month and RM79 (US$19) at each monthly renewal. You see the full amount before you pay.

faqs.q: What does the price cover?
faqs.a: Your website, built by our studio from your brief, with 4 free extras, a money-back guarantee and lifetime tech support. A domain we register for you is in your own name, so it always stays yours. If tax applies where you are, you see it before you pay.

faqs.q: How does the money-back guarantee work?
faqs.a: We agree the delivery date and the scope with you first. If we miss either, you get a full refund. If a delay comes from your side, the date simply moves with it.

faqs.q: What is lifetime tech support?
faqs.a: Questions answered and small tweaks handled for as long as you use the site, at no charge.

faqs.q: Can I pay in ringgit or US dollars?
faqs.a: Yes. Switch the prices to the currency you prefer. You are charged in the currency shown on your order.

faqs.q: What comes free?
faqs.a: Every package comes with competitor analysis, website conversion plan, SEO and AIO optimisation and a Logo Health Check. They are part of the package, not an extra to buy later.

faqs.q: Can I use one of your builds as a reference?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick up to 3 from our portfolio, or paste links to sites you like. References guide the look. A fully custom design is our Premium service.

faqs.q: Do I need my own domain?
faqs.a: No. If you have a domain, we connect it at no extra cost. If you do not, we register one in your name for RM100 (US$25) once, and renewal is included while your plan is active. You can also start on a free Brand Method address and decide later.

faqs.q: Can I cancel?
faqs.a: Yes. Cancel from your billing dashboard. Your website stays live through the period you have paid for.

faqs.q: Who owns the website?
faqs.a: You own your domain and your content. On Launch and Grow the site runs on our platform while your plan is active. Choose Own It if you want the code and the files.

faqs.q: Will it appear on Google and in AI answers?
faqs.a: We set up SEO and AIO, so search engines and AI answers such as ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews can read your site. They decide if and when to show it. Results are not guaranteed.

faqs.q: I need a store, bookings or a portal.
faqs.a: That is Premium: custom design, a CMS and high quality SEO.

faqs.q: How long does it take?
faqs.a: A Business Website in 10 days, a Growth Website in 2 weeks, a Corporate Website & Portal in about 3 weeks. Your launch date is fixed in writing before work starts.

faqs.q: What is the money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: If we miss the agreed date or the agreed scope, you get a full refund. It covers the Business Website and the Growth Website. The Corporate Website & Portal is paid by milestone.

faqs.q: What comes free?
faqs.a: Every Premium package comes with high quality SEO and AIO optimisation free, worth RM5,000 (US$2,000), a CMS, a competitor analysis and a website conversion plan.

faqs.q: Will my site show up on Google and in AI answers?
faqs.a: Every site is built with SEO and AIO optimisation: clean structure, fast pages, structured data and clear answers that Google, ChatGPT and AI Overviews can read. They decide what to show, so we do not promise a position.

faqs.q: Can I edit the site myself?
faqs.a: Yes. Every package includes a CMS, so you change text, images and posts without a developer.

faqs.q: What support do I get after launch?
faqs.a: Lifetime tech support, free. Questions answered and small tweaks handled for as long as you use the site.

faqs.q: Can you build more than a website?
faqs.a: Yes. Scoped projects cover online stores, apps, portals, CRM, AI automation, AI assistants and data crawlers.

faqs.q: Do I own the website?
faqs.a: Our custom website packages specify the handover of code, domain and content. Your proposal confirms the agreed scope and any third party licences.

faqs.q: Is hosting or a care plan mandatory?
faqs.a: No. An owned custom build does not require an ongoing Brand Method care contract unless you choose one. Outside hosting and software costs may still apply.

faqs.q: Can I apply for a government grant?
faqs.a: Eligibility depends on a currently open official scheme and on your business and project. We can discuss your digitalisation scope, but we do not promise funding, official endorsement or eligibility.

faqs.q: I only need a simple website.
faqs.a: Our Standard packages start at RM79 (US$19) a month, or RM1,900 (US$465) once to own it.
